svg.aria-label: Upper voice: E4 4 to 10 s, F4 14 to 20 s, E4 26 to 32 s (rests in between). Lower voice: C4 0 to 12 s, B3 12 to 24 s, C4 24 to 36 s. The lower voice changes at 12 and 24 seconds while the upper voice rests. From 14 to 20 seconds the sounding pair is B3 + F4, a diminished fifth of 6 semitones, in the tritone colour.
svg.title: Version B: the landscape begins to travel

g.text: The lower voice changes at 12 s and 24 s,
while the upper voice is resting.
How to read this graphic: The dashed lines at
12 and 24 seconds mark where the lower voice
changes. At both moments the upper lane is a
dashed rest, so no pair changes at that
instant. The F4 only sounds from 14 to 20
seconds, over B3, and that band carries the
